svg.desc: In a width-four window, pair A/B and pair C/D are compared sequentially on one thread. A matches and C misses, freeing slots for E and F. B and D retain their collision positions. Each completed result is written to its original input position.
svg.title: SIMD residual states and slot refill
SIMD residual states and slot refill
